_about: The AI content team as the operator dashboard's Fully AI Social tab shows it. build.py bakes this into the page (no client data). One entry per employee; 'agent' is its file in .claude/agents/. status: live (working), training (being trained), later (not started). Update when an employee's status changes.

people.name: Tait
people.sub: the idea, the camera, the decision

employees.name: Team Lead
employees.job: Runs the team room: decides who works next, settles disagreements, and brings Tait in only at the approval gates.

employees.name: Account Manager
employees.job: Interviews clients (voice-memo questions or a sheet for Tait), asks follow-ups, and writes the ICP, brand guidelines and voice docs.

employees.name: Content Researcher
employees.job: Finds what works in the client's niche: topics (customer questions) and formats (outlier ways to package a video). Instagram first.

employees.name: Content Strategist
employees.job: Pairs real customer pains with proven formats and plans the month, weighing Tait's ideas equally with research.

employees.name: Content Writer
employees.job: Writes each video card: hook, script, outline and interview question, with placeholders for anything the client fills in on camera.

employees.name: Content Expert
employees.job: Tait's taste: scores every idea and card 1-10 (Film it / Fix it / Kill it), sends weak work back, writes filming instructions.

employees.name: Content Editor
employees.job: Edits footage in Remotion from the client's Style Profile, using only graphics Tait approved, and pitches new ones.

employees.name: Motion Graphics Designer
employees.job: Showreel-level motion graphics across 51 styles (Swiss, kinetic type, split-flap, glassmorphism, isometric, paper collage…), picking the right style for each moment and growing each client's approved graphics library.

employees.name: Content Reviewer
employees.job: Motion Director: says no. Checks every graphic against the graphics standard (evidence, not effects; no scam tells) and every edit frame by frame, and sends timestamped fixes to the Editor until it passes.

employees.name: Content Poster
employees.job: Prepares captions, tags, platforms and post times. A person posts.
